messages:
olivia: Hey team — want to set a short sync next week to go over the latest inference performance readouts and decide next optimization triage steps. Thinking 30–45m.

olivia: Proposed agenda (quick):
```
1) benchmark readout: p50/p95/p99 across model variants
2) cost/unit breakdown + hot routes
3) redispatch/quantization experiments status
4) blockers & action items (canaries, infra quotas)
```

olivia: Can everyone drop availability? Prefer Tue/Wed morning PT. Also please add any must-cover items.

raj: Tue morning works for me (10am PT). Add: comparison of batch-size sensitivity for long prompts.

maria-g: Wed is better for me. Also: include the dashboard link and the test harness run IDs so I can pre-check regressions.

tim: I can do Tue 10am PT but only 30m. Will need the short list of failing configs up front.

hao: Wed 9am PT for me. If we go Tue, can we record — I might be late. Also add data quality checks (sample skew).

benchmark-bot: New benchmark run available: run_id=2026-03-10-42, summary: p50=28ms, p95=134ms, p99=410ms (gpt-small-v2 q4_0). Link: https://bench.internal/runs/2026-03-10-42

olivia: Thanks — ok looks like we have split availability. Proposal: Tue 10am PT to prioritize quick triage (30m) with recording, and Wed 9am PT as the deep readout (45m) for folks who want to dig into batch/long-prompt sensitivity.

maria-g: SGTM. For Wed deep readout I'll prepare:
- run diffs (2026-03-03 -> 2026-03-10)
- sampling details + seed list
- heatmap of per-model latency vs batch

raj: I'll prepare the cost/unit breakdown and quick script showing cost delta for q4 vs fp16.

tim: I'll drop the list of failing configs to the thread by EOD today.

hao: Can someone add a bullet for 'fallback policy behavior under overloaded routers'? I want to confirm we don't see doubled token cost on fallback.

olivia: Good call — adding to both agendas. Also: can the infra team enable a temporary higher quota on the dedicated pool for Wed deep reads? @eng-sre please advise.

benchmark-bot: Quota check: dedicated-pool-3 current cap 1200 concurrent tokens/s. Request flag required for bump >1500.

olivia: Noted. I'll open a ticket with SRE.

maria-g: Pre-reads: I'll upload diffs + perf plots to the shared drive and post the link by tomorrow morning.

raj: If we want to be efficient, can we agree on success criteria: e.g., p95 < 180ms for hot routes OR clear rollback plan to previous model? Saves debate time.

olivia: Love that. I'll add a 'decision checklist' to the doc: measurable target, rollback path, owner, estimated cost delta.

tim: :thumbsup:

olivia: Final Qs: Tue 10am PT (30m) recorded for triage; Wed 9am PT (45m) deep readout. I'll send calendar invites in a few. If anyone else must be on the invite, ping me here.

hao: Can you cc me even if I'm late — I have a client call during Tue 10am but will join if it runs long.

maria-g: I'll also list the exact query samples we used so SRE can replicate load pattern.

olivia: Great — thanks all. Calendar invites on their way.
